top_signals.title: Ex-Deutsche Trader Bittar Has Rate-Fixing Conviction Quashed
top_signals.summary: Former Deutsche Bank AG trader Christian Bittar has had his conviction over fixing benchmark interest rates quashed, despite pleading guilty more than eight years ago.

top_signals.title: Health and Power 'Deeply Connected for Women': Melinda French Gates
top_signals.summary: Health and power are "deeply connected for women", according to Melinda French Gates, who says the world is "way behind on women's health". French Gates joined Francine Lacqua on "The Pulse" to discuss new Gallup-Pivotal research, which finds more than four in ten UK women say their health has kept them from doing everything they wanted to do, with gaps in information and care at key stages of their lives. In the US, more than half of women reported a negative healthcare experience in the past five years. The research was conducted with Pivotal, founded by French Gates to advance social progress for women and young people.  (Source: Bloomberg)
